description: This Java class implements a UI control for navigating through charts, providing previous and next page buttons with associated keyboard shortcuts, and updating the display accordingly.

classes.name: ChartScrollControl
classes.description: UI component that provides navigation controls to scroll through charts with buttons and keyboard bindings.

methods.name: ChartScrollControl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the control with a listener and sets up UI components and key bindings.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous chart, wrapping around if at the beginning.

methods.name: showChart
methods.description: Displays the chart at the current index and notifies the listener.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next chart, if available.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for navigating charts.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the control UI.

methods.name: setInfoText
methods.description: Updates the label with current index and total number of charts.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the index to zero and updates the display.
